title: A failure followed by a recorded successful re-run, zero-failure counts, and failure-handling descriptions do not block
text: 失敗時は退避済み状態へ戻す処理を追加した。テストが3件失敗していた問題も修正した。残リスク: なし。
evidence: 検証証拠: 最初の実行は pytest 3 failed。原因を修正し再実行して pytest 120 passed, 0 failed。受入証拠: REQ-1 の期待値と120件の結果が一致。
rationale: Failure handling as a feature, a past failure state, a zero count, and a failure closed by a later recorded re-verification are not open failures.
